request: Match both holographic faces to the supplied realistic cyan portrait reference
method: Reference-derived high-detail open/closed portrait atlas on sculpted relief geometry, articulated head and real eyelid morphs
scope: Both faces and swept-back hair; retain colors, placement, scale, dresses, wind, head movement, blinking, reduced-motion support and room geometry
generator: Built-in imagegen; user reference supplied as identity/style input

limitations: Close interpretation rather than exact dimensional replica
Shallow portrait relief with some fixed image-like shading and hair detail; unrestricted viewing angles not established
Central face more solid than reference volumetric glow
Facial detail subtle at normal apartment viewing distance
Independent reviewer assessed sampled poses, not direct motion playback

validation.portraitFrames: 10 actual production-renderer 1920x1080 frames, including known open/closed and turned-head states
validation.headMotion: Actual local quaternion changes independently within body
validation.blinkRhythms: Two unequal independent interval sequences, checked across 40 seconds at 30 samples/s
validation.reducedMotion: Actual runtime snapshot unchanged after advancing 12 seconds
validation.preservedFit: All 270 TV rays clear; fitted bedding gaps below 0.001mm; no nightstand intersection
validation.floorPlanParity: Architecture, circulation and furnishing placement unchanged; prior actual-mesh plan retained

round2Corrections: Reduce and broaden nose relief to agree with portrait landmarks
Share exact face/core tessellation to remove diverging depth edges
Raise lid surfaces 0.75mm and feather closed-atlas corners to ensure continuous closure
